claims: National average 30-year FHA mortgage rates are hovering around 5.875% to 6.32% as of April 7, 2026.
Many top lenders offer 30-year fixed options around 6.12%.
30-year fixed FHA rates commonly range between 5.875% and 6.32% as of April 2026.
30-year FHA refinance rates are around 6.45% to 6.50%.
FHA loans require a minimum down payment of 3.5%.
FHA loans require an upfront mortgage insurance premium (MIP).
Annual MIP is added to the monthly payment for FHA loans.
